scope: Project technical checks mapped to selected NIST CSF 2.0 outcomes; not a compliance certification

scoring.method: Equal weight per check within each framework
scoring.assessedPassRate: Pass / (Pass + Fail); unavailable when denominator is zero
scoring.note: Not assessed and Review required never count as Pass; no compliance grade

checks.title: Firewall diagnostics configured
checks.requiredEvidence: Enabled network-rule logs sent to the selected workspace

checks.title: Recent network logs available
checks.requiredEvidence: Logs observed for the selected firewall and time range

checks.title: Allow rules have restricted sources
checks.requiredEvidence: Inspect rules, inherited policies and referenced IP groups

checks.title: Allow rules have restricted destinations and ports
checks.requiredEvidence: Identify wildcard destinations, broad tags and port ranges

checks.title: Management ports restricted
checks.requiredEvidence: Inspect Allow and DNAT rules for SSH/RDP exposure

checks.title: Traffic enforcement test verified
checks.requiredEvidence: Timestamped probe results matched to Allow/Deny firewall logs
